description: One brief per elected page type, written by scripts/page_brief.py into working/pages/page-brief-<page>.v<N>.json. Immutable once written; a re-run writes the next version. The runtime enforcement is page_brief.validate_brief (fail-closed at write time); this file is the contract a page builder (Item 21) codes against. Pattern follows Skill 71's assets/brand/brand.schema.json.

approved_checkout_url.description: Sales and checkout briefs. Present only when the run supplied APPROVED_CHECKOUT_URL / CHECKOUT_URL and it validated as binding (absolute http(s), non-placeholder host, deck/company slug bound). A supplied-but-unbound URL refuses the brief fail-closed; it is never silently dropped.

brand.description: Filled client-brand block on the Skill 71 brand.schema.json pattern. Values the run does not carry are the CLIENT_MUST_SUPPLY sentinel or null, never invented; palette roles not in palette_client_supplied are engine defaults and are labeled as such.

consent.description: Checkout briefs carry the full block; VSL briefs carry posture + ruling for the viewer-gate form. Posture is the owner ruling of 2026-10-13 (all boxes required to proceed), superseding the 2026-09-27 D3 optional posture.

text.description: The checkbox text IS the consent sentence (benefit-first copy).

copy_blocks.description: The approved copy for this page, embedded verbatim so the builder never writes or guesses copy. kind 'builder-copy' is the deterministic builder copy the current pipeline renders; 'phase-fragment' is the agent copy phase's fragment; 'research' is VSL research.

cta.description: Sales briefs only: the CTA action and its href resolution semantics.

sops.description: GIP v2.0 doctrine references (SOP-GIP-01 v2.0, SOP-GIP-02 v2.0) per Item 25's doctrine-weave.

canonical_paths.description: Where the answer lives in intake.json: the nested pre_presentation_capture path (preferred) and the flat top-level path (fallback), per Item 12's repaired writer.

decision.description: A brief exists only for decision 'build'. Declined (waived), unanswered (defer) and fail-closed elections write NO brief; they are recorded in working/checkpoints/page_briefs.json, the seam ledger.

toggle_field.description: Sales and checkout share the WANT_SALES_CHECKOUT election (one election, two page types); VSL uses WANT_VSL_PAGE.

form.description: Checkout briefs only: the Skill 44 form contract summary.

intent.description: A brief never promises live payment; a live intent is a builder blocker by design.

hosted.description: Every GHL-hosted media URL recorded in the run's media_library ledger.

model.description: Owner decision 4 (2026-10-13): the client selects their model (or their configured default applies); recommendations are guidance with reasons, in a separate list with a distinct shape, and are never written into a selection. Selections are read only from the profile's model_choices selection field (Item 17's record); recommendations only from its recommendations_shown log.

model_plan_slots.description: The run's model_plan slot snapshot when the profile carries one, for reference; it is not a selection record.

response.description: offered | accepted | declined, as recorded when shown.

offer.description: checkout_form_builder.resolve_offer's shape, extended with the wider deck_brief copy facts. amount_minor is integer cents; it is null only when the run carries no parseable price, never an invented number.

shared_funnel.description: One-funnel rule: sales, checkout and VSL are pages inside the SAME funnel for one client.

emitting_phases.description: The manifest phase ids whose outputs complete this page's inputs (copy + design phases).

location_id.description: The bound GHL location id, or 'unbound-test' when no location is bound. Credentials never enter a brief; only this non-secret id travels.

run_id.description: The run folder name; receipts must match it.

supersedes.description: Run-relative path of the previous version of this page's brief, or null for v1. The superseded file is never edited.

vsl.description: VSL briefs only: the webinar video and the viewer gate.

timestamp_seconds.description: Derived from the run's webinar_timing.json slide boundaries inside the 180-480s window by vsl_builder.resolve_gate_timestamp; never a hardcoded constant.

title: Presentation run page brief (FIX-PLAN Item 20 seam, presentations side)
